'''''Heptapleurum heptaphyllum''''' is a [[species]] of [[flowering plant]] in the family [[Araliaceae]], native to southern China, Indo-China and Japan.<ref name=POWO_77196882-1/> It was first described by [[Carl Linnaeus]] in 1771 as ''Vitis heptaphylla''.<ref name=IPNI_77196882-1/>

''Schefflera rubriflora'' was assessed as "[[Critically Endangered|critically endangered]]" in the 2004 IUCN Red List, where it was considered endemic to [[Yunnan]] in China,<ref name=iucn/> but {{As of|2023|January|lc=yes}} was treated as part of the much more widely distributed ''Heptapleurum heptaphyllum''.<ref name=POWO_77196882-1/>
